newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Lenenergo utility shares up 19pct.
newsitem.headline: Russia Lenenergo utility shares up 19pct.

text.p: Shares of Russian regional utility Lenenergo rose 19.3 percent and broke the $1.00 barrier in early Wednesday trade, marking $1.05 at 0945 GMT from $0.88 at Tuesday's close.
Reported share volume on the Russian Trading System (RTS) for Lenenergo was 400,000.
Preferred shares of Lenenergo showed sharp gains on lower volumes, rising to $0.68 from $0.59 on 57,000 shares.
Lenenergo has shown strong gains recently as investors move to second-tier stocks in a general market rally. The RTS 24-share index hit a new record on Wednesday morning.
